title: A walk in the forest
instructions: Nina ormanda yaptığı yürüyüşü anlatıyor. Olanları ve gördüklerini takip et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last Sunday, my husband and I went for a long walk in the forest near our town.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We walked for about three hours and saw two deer!

script.speaker: s
script.text: We had a picnic next to a small river.

script.speaker: s
script.text: On the way back, it started to rain, and we got very wet.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But it was still a lovely day.

questions.evidence: We walked for about three hours

questions.prompt: What happened on the way back?
questions.feedback: Dönüşte yağmur başladı ve çok ıslandılar.
